verses.1:
A song of ascents.
 In my distress I cried to the LORD,
 and He answered me.
verses.2:
Deliver my soul, O LORD,
 from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
verses.3:
What will He do to you,
 and what will be added to you,
 O deceitful tongue?
verses.4:
Sharp arrows will come from the warrior,
 with burning coals of the broom tree!
verses.5:
Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech,
 that I live among the tents of Kedar!
verses.6:
Too long have I dwelt
 among those who hate peace.
verses.7:
I am in favor of peace;
 but when I speak, they want war.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
